title: La Edad de Oro
author: José Martí
note: La Edad de Oro (Martí, 1889), the four issues of his magazine for the children of America: 27 pieces (stories, poems, articles, and each issue's closing letter, La última página), each an item of its own. Headings are the titles as written in the contents, matched in order after it. Dropped: poem markers (/P, P/), part numbers (--I--), italics.
